items.unit: HUF/kg ex-VAT (hot-dip, batch, structural steel)
items.basis: Not found. No Hungarian hot-dip galvaniser (tűzihorganyzó) publishes a HUF/kg list that surfaced in three searches. The Hungarian Hot Dip Galvanizers Association (Magyar Tűzihorganyzók Szövetsége) states only how it is charged: on the mass of the FINISHED galvanised goods (zinc pick-up included), driven by design, steel grade, quantity and the world zinc price; it compares the first galvanising of an average structure to a good two-coat paint system. The only HUF/kg figure for hot-dip (daibau.hu, 3,000 Ft/kg) is galvanised steelwork INCLUDING site erection, undated — excluded.
items.notes: Electro-zinc prices found are a different process — see services.electroZincPerKg (reference only). Read from search-result snippets: the host is not reachable from this environment (DNS refused), so the figure was not read on the page itself — re-read before it sets a rate.

items.unit: HUF/m² ex-VAT (standard RAL, sheet / small parts, job shop list)
items.basis: Mean of the two job-shop list prices in the four clusters: Debrecen (Hajdú-Bihar) RAL basic 4,600 Ft/m² net, RAL 1000–4000 colours 5,000 Ft/m², '27% ÁFA not included'; Szalcsa Porfestés (near Székesfehérvár, Central Transdanubia) sheet > 0.5 m² from 5,000 Ft/m² net, valid from 2026-08-01. (4,600 + 5,000) / 2 = 4,800 Ft/m² = €13.17/m² at 364.42. Range seen: Colorsztatik 'serial' RAL basic from 3,300 Ft + Áfa/m² (custom from 5,500) — the closest to a series price (http://www.colorsztatik.hu/arjegyzek.html, undated); Takács Művek list from 2026-02-01: RAL basic 5,670, special colours 7,370, lacquer 10,835 Ft/m² ex-27% VAT, doubled above 10 mm material (http://takacsmuvek.hu/Takacs_Muvek-arlista.pdf); Maczkó Kft. small lots 8,000 Ft/m² net (https://maczkokft.hu/hu/porfestes); Pere és Társa from 2,000 Ft/m² (VAT not stated, https://porszoras.hu/).
items.date: 2026 (Szalcsa valid from 2026-08-01; Takács from 2026-02-01; Debrecen undated live page)
items.notes: Second cluster source: https://www.szalcsaporfestes.hu/ . Job-shop / small-lot prices, not an automotive volume line — an upper bound for a volume part (the serial 3,300 Ft/m² is a better floor). Cross-check: Poland kb.pl ~50 PLN/m² ex-VAT (≈ €11.4) and COATINC Bochum €55/m² (Oct 2025) — carried from poland-2026-10/research/r2-overhead-logistics-services.json and germany-2026-10/research/r2-overhead-logistics-services.json; Hungary sits with Poland. items.unit: HUF/h ex-VAT (CNC milling, 3-axis, job shop, all-in shop rate)
items.basis: Mean of two published job-shop ranges: JE-ZO Kft. CNC milling 6,000–7,500 Ft/h (midpoint 6,750; page footer ©2026); Alten CNC milling 6,000–8,000 Ft + Áfa/h (midpoint 7,000; 'indicative, not an offer', undated, https://alten.hu/esztergalas_arak.html). (6,750 + 7,000) / 2 = 6,875 Ft/h = €18.87/h. Turning: JE-ZO 5,500–6,500 Ft/h, Alten 4,500–6,000 Ft + Áfa/h. Higher outlier: Profi Forgácsolás CNC milling 15,000 Ft/h, turning 8,000 Ft/h (https://profiforgacsolas.hu/, undated).
items.notes: JE-ZO snippet does not state VAT basis; locations not stated in snippets. Small-shop rates. Cross-check with the current book: mach-vmc3 3,231.6 Ft/h (machine only) + lab-uk-skilled 3,982.26 Ft/h = 7,213.86 Ft/h BEFORE overhead and margin — already above the published job-shop all-in rate (6,875) and the Alten midpoint (7,000); suggests the book's Hungary CNC machine + labour stack is on the high side, but small-shop list rates are not a firm basis to call it wrong. items.unit: HUF/km (domestic, 16 t payload trailer combination, carrier list)
items.basis: Fuvarcenter 2026 price list: per-km rate rises with payload, 300 Ft/km (0.5 t) up to 950 Ft/km for a 16 t trailer set. 950 Ft/km = €2.61/km at 364.42. Other Hungarian figures: Bástifuvar (Vác) box / tarpaulin truck 250 Ft/km countryside, 300 Ft/km Budapest, maximum-utilisation rate 530 Ft/km (https://bastifuvar.hu/fuvarozasi-dijak/); a carrier cost model gives full cost ≈ 405 Ft/km and a suggested market price ≈ 580–600 Ft/km (illustrative, https://www.kamionshopkft.hu/fuvarar-kepzes-mibol-all-ossze-a-km-dij).
items.notes: LOW confidence for an automotive FTL lane: small-carrier domestic list prices for part / short loads, VAT basis not stated in the snippet, and not a 13.6 m / 24 t articulated contract rate (CEE-origin benchmark lanes run €1.45–1.73/km — see logistics.ftlPerKm.CEE_reference). items.unit: HU ÷ UK logistics £/part
items.basis: NOT SUPPORTED — no UK domestic per-km rate (as in the Poland and Germany rounds) and no Hungarian automotive FTL contract rate were found. Directional: CEE-origin contract lanes (€1.45–1.73/km) are ~0.56–0.67 of a West-European lane (Duisburg–Lille €2.58/km); 1.45 / 2.58 = 0.56, 1.73 / 2.58 = 0.67. A logistics multiplier of 1.22 can hold only if the Hungarian supplier's lane to its OEM is ~1.8–2.2× (1.22 / 0.67 to 1.22 / 0.56) the UK supplier's — a distance assumption, not a researched figure.
items.notes: Keep 1.22 labelled as an unresearched assumption.

items.unit: HUF/pallet ex-VAT (new EUR / EPAL 1200×800, single-unit webshop price)
items.basis: Three Hungarian distributors' own published prices, net: Zovapack new UIC-EUR 800×1200 5,197 Ft + ÁFA (6,600 Ft gross; 5,197 × 1.27 = 6,600); Fiorex new EPAL-EUR 80×120 heat-treated 5,252 Ft + ÁFA (listing marked unavailable, expiring 2026-09, https://www.fiorex.hu/epal-eur-uj-raklap-80x120-2133); Raklap Budafok new EUR pallet 5,300 Ft net (undated, https://raklapbudafok.hu/oldal/raklap-arak/). Mean (5,197 + 5,252 + 5,300) / 3 = 5,249.7 → 5,250 Ft = €14.41 at 364.42. Cross-check (carried from germany-2026-10 r2 file): DACH new EUR-1 index €12.21 (Aug 2026, Tacto / PalettenReport) × 364.42 = 4,450 Ft; Hungary single-unit webshop / DACH index = 5,250 / 4,450 = 1.18.
items.date: 2026 (live pages, Oct 2026 search; Fiorex listing to 2026-09)
items.notes: Single-unit / small-lot prices, Budapest area; a plant buying by the truckload pays less. Outliers excluded: Csomagolás Király 15,993 Ft/db (likely a multi-pallet unit), Europellet 6,000 Ft (VAT basis unclear), a 2025 classified ad 4,900 Ft (marketplace — RULES). items.unit: % (SBS gross operating rate / personnel-cost share, NACE C29)
items.basis: Not found. Eurostat SBS (sbs_ovw_act, NACE C29, HU v UK) could not be read: ec.europa.eu is refused by this environment's proxy and the values did not appear in snippets. Fragments only, from different years and so NOT combined: Hungary motor-vehicle manufacturing turnover ≈ €17.71 bn (2023) and personnel costs ≈ €692.27 m (2021), Statista citing Eurostat (https://www.statista.com/statistics/428821/turnover-motor-vehicles-hungary). items.notes: Lead: MNB Hitelintézeti Szemle paper 'Insight into the Hungarian Automotive Industry in International Comparison' (Rechnitzer, Hausmann, Tóth) uses SBS value added = personnel costs + operating result + depreciation (https://hitelintezetiszemle.mnb.hu/sw/static/file/janos-rechnitzer-robert-hausmann-tamas-toth.pdf). Keep overheadMultiplier 0.83 labelled as an unresearched assumption.

notes: FX: €1 = 364.42 HUF, MNB official rate of 25 Sep 2026 as republished by an aggregator (https://allratestoday.com/central-bank-rates-api/mnb.md; a second copy of the site gives 364.64) — mnb.hu was not readable here.
